mentions.note: died 1971; joined October 1921; won Blackstaffe Shield (club 7 miles XC championship) 1923, 2nd 1922, 3rd 1924; 91st and first Belgrave scorer in National XC at Beaconsfield 1923

share.d: J.G. (Jimmy) Flatt in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1971: 1 mention in 1 issue and 1 race result.
